title: BECE English Studies: Vocabulary & Register - English Studies - Collocations
subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

The principal warned the students against engaging in examination ________.
questions.explain: In an educational context, cheating in exams is collocated with the word 'malpractice', making 'examination malpractice' the standard accepted phrase.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

The speaker warned the youths about the serious dangers of consuming ________ drugs.
questions.explain: The word 'drugs' naturally collocates with 'hard' to describe illegal, addictive substances like heroin or cocaine (i.e., 'hard drugs').
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

Advocacy groups are actively campaigning for equal ________ for men and women in the workplace.
questions.explain: The phrase 'equal opportunities' is a standard collocation used in discussions regarding gender equality and fairness in employment.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

During general elections, all eligible citizens are highly encouraged to ________ their votes.
questions.explain: The verb 'cast' strongly collocates with 'vote' to describe the action of formally recording one's choice in an election.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

After abruptly quitting the addictive substance, the patient began to experience severe ________ symptoms such as aggressive shaking, insomnia, and fever.
questions.explain: 'Withdrawal symptoms' is a standard medical and rehabilitative collocation used to describe the abnormal physical and mental effects experienced after a person stops using an addictive drug.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

The elder statesman lamented the alarming rate of moral ________ among the present generation of youths, aggressively urging them to embrace core national integrity.
questions.explain: 'Moral decadence' is a recognized formal collocation used extensively to describe a severe deterioration in the moral values and disciplined behaviors of a society.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

To successfully prevent dictatorship, a functioning democratic government heavily relies on an enforced system of checks and ________ among the executive, legislative, and judicial branches.
questions.explain: 'Checks and balances' is a fundamental governmental and political collocation describing a system where distinct branches of government share power to prevent any single branch from exerting excessive dominance.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

Attaining genuine gender ________ inside major corporate structures requires that male and female employees undeniably receive strictly equivalent financial compensation for equivalent labor.
questions.explain: 'Gender parity' is a prominent socio-political collocation referring to statistical indicators aiming to reflect equal access, opportunities, and conditions for men and women.
questions.subject: English Studies
